context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 臨時/外側/民生/自前/和風/出会える/全般/丁度

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、臨時、絶対、ボーナス、絶対、もらったらしいわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad got his bonus — seriously, he really did.
lines.style: Bright, animated delivery. Opens with warmth toward Sho. Picks up pace on the news itself. Light emphasis on the confirmation — she's genuinely pleased to share this with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、外側、絶対、ペンキ、絶対、塗り直すんでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Mom, Dad's really going to repaint the outside of the house, right? For real?
lines.style: Curious, slightly uncertain lilt upward at the end. Quiet thinking-aloud quality. Sho is connecting dots — paint, bonus — processing out loud with genuine interest, not skepticism.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの会社、本気で、絶対、民生、絶対、用品、絶対、扱ってるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father's company handles consumer goods, Sho — that's what he does.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact explanation. A soft teaching tone, not condescending. Slight pause before naming the product category, as if she's choosing the clearest words for a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんの、絶対、自前、絶対、の野菜、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: I really like Grandpa's vegetables — the ones he grows himself.
lines.style: Warm, genuine appreciation in the voice. Small, sincere smile in the tone. No performance — just honest affection for his grandfather's garden and what it produces.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、和風、絶対、お料理、絶対、ママも、絶対、習いたいわ
lines.en: I wish I could learn to cook like Grandma does — her Japanese cooking is so good.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful tone. Admiring without being overdone. The tempo slows slightly on 'like Grandma' — real affection there. Not a complaint, more a quiet wish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、新しい、絶対、お友達、絶対、出会える、絶対、よね
lines.en: Mom, do you think I'll meet new friends?
lines.style: Small, hopeful voice with underlying uncertainty. Builds slightly on the question — seeking reassurance but not demanding it. Open-ended, genuine curiosity about what's coming.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家のお掃除、本気で、絶対、全般、絶対、ちゃんとしましょうね、翔くん
lines.en: We should make sure the house is clean, shouldn't we, Sho?
lines.style: Gentle directive tone, practical but warm. A soft suggestion more than an order — inviting agreement rather than issuing commands. The 'shouldn't we' is collaborative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お風呂の温度、本気で、絶対、丁度、絶対、いいよ、ママ
lines.en: The bath temperature is just right, Mom.
lines.style: Contented, reassuring observation. Delivered with a small, genuine satisfaction. Sho is offering her a quiet compliment — the temperature is perfect, she's done it right. Warm close.
